# the Machine in the Garden

> the Machine in the Garden is an independent gothic/etherealwave duo formed in 1992 by Roger Fracé and Summer Bowman. This website provides band news, discography, music, images, biography, live shows, merchandise, official links, and site policies.

This site is maintained by the band. Images, music, and other copyrighted material on this site are not licensed for training or improvement of machine learning models.

## Home

- [Home](https://www.tmitg.com/): Official homepage with band overview, featured news, and core navigation.

## News

- [News](https://www.tmitg.com/news.php): Latest announcements, show updates, and archived news.

## Discography

- [Discography](https://www.tmitg.com/discog.php): Album and release information, cover art, and music history.
- [Places in Between](https://www.tmitg.com/places.php): The Machine in the Garden's most recent full-length release, from 2020.
- [Space-Time](https://www.tmitg.com/spacetime.php): The Machine in the Garden's most recent single.

## Music

- [Music](https://www.tmitg.com/music.php): Release details, audio information, and music resources.

- [Bio](https://www.tmitg.com/bio.php): Band history, member profiles, and background information.
